title: Finite generating slices cover the site
statement: Let $(C,J,O)$ be a small ringed site, $I$ a module sheaf, and $\iota:I\to O$ linear. Suppose $I$ is of finite type, in the sense of Mathlib $\operatorname{IsFiniteType}$ [def-weil-pbc-ringed-ideal-generators]. There exist a covering family $U:A\to C$, with $A$ in the universe of $C$, and a specified finite generating list for $I|_{U(a)}$ through $\iota$ for every $a\in A$. Consequently the family of all specified finite generating slices [def-weil-pbc-ringed-ideal-generating-index] is covering.

proof.text: Take the local generators data furnished by the definition of IsFiniteType. Reindex each finite generator type by Fin of its cardinality; apply ι and evaluate at the terminal object of its slice. These data satisfy the specified-list predicate. Enlarge this covering subfamily to all specified generating slices.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteIdealGeneratingCover
    {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    (O : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
    (I : ringedSiteModules.{u} ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O))
    (ι : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj O))
    [I.IsFiniteType] :
    ∃ (A : Type u) (U : A → C) (r : A → ℕ)
      (f : ∀ a : A, Fin (r a) → O.obj.obj (op (U a))),
      J.CoversTop U ∧ ∀ a : A, IsRingedIdealGeneratingList O I ι (U a) (r a) (f a)
